pages.barcodesDescription: Browse merchandise barcodes created with invoices (line items + labels).
pages.description: Scan a merchandise barcode (from an invoice label) to update its status, container, or route.

section.title: Label activity ({{count}})
section.description: Creation, status changes, container updates, routes, and print events for this invoice.
section.empty: No label activity yet. Generate labels from the Labels tab to start tracking changes.

options.title: Update options
options.description: Select one or more fields to apply on each barcode scan.
options.barcodeHint: Field clears automatically after each update so you can scan the next label.

results.title: Barcode Changes
results.description: Green messages succeeded; red messages failed. Only changed fields are filled per row.
results.empty: Scan a barcode to see results here.

errors.selectAtLeastOne: Select at least one field to update (status, container, or route).
errors.noChanges: Already up to date — selected values match the current label.

staging.title: Label manager
staging.lineItemsDescription: Review line items from the selected invoices, choose which to label, then generate labels.
staging.labelsDescription: Barcodes come from the invoice (line items + labels). Retrieved where they already exist; gap-filled only when missing. Manage status, container, and printing below.
staging.filterPlaceholder: Filter by invoice, barcode, status, container, description…

removeDialog.lineItemsDescription: Remove {{count}} line item from this list? It will not be included when generating labels.
removeDialog.lineItemsDescription_plural: Remove {{count}} line items from this list? They will not be included when generating labels.
removeDialog.labelsDescription: Remove {{count}} label from this list? This does not delete the barcode from the system.
removeDialog.labelsDescription_plural: Remove {{count}} labels from this list? This does not delete barcodes from the system.
removeDialog.oneLabelDescription: Remove this label from the list? This does not delete the barcode from the system.

staging.noLineItems: No line items to stage. Close and select invoices with line items.
staging.noLabelsMatch: No labels match the current filter.

containerDialog.title: Transfer container
containerDialog.description: Move {{count}} selected label(s) to another container.

routeDialog.title: Assign route
routeDialog.description: Choose a daily route for {{count}} selected label, or create a new daily route. Only labels with a container are assigned.
routeDialog.description_plural: Choose a daily route for {{count}} selected labels, or create a new daily route. Only labels with a container are assigned.

errors.noneGenerated: No labels were generated for the selected line items.
errors.missingBarcodeNumbers: Selected labels are missing barcode numbers to update.
errors.missingBarcodesForRoute: Selected labels have no saved barcodes to assign to a route.
errors.missingBarcodeNumbersPrint: Selected labels are missing barcode numbers to print.

output.title: Barcode Changes
output.description: Green messages succeeded; red messages failed. Only changed fields are filled per row.
